design_angle.variable: stitch direction, across shapes: one design angle for shapes with no house of their own
design_angle.basis: 09-18 labelled sitting: design_angle read no difference on 8 of 9 logos, before better on tires (docs/kent-review-2026-09-18.md). flow_circvar measures direction spread WITHIN a shape, which this flag does not target, so it is registered with no required movement; whether flow_circvar moves is measured, not assumed.

polygon_axis.variable: stitch direction, within satin: the skeleton axis is read from the artwork polygon, not the grown one
polygon_axis.basis: 09-18 labelled sitting: no difference on 8 of 9, both bad on enthusiast (docs/kent-review-2026-09-18.md).

split_7mm.variable: stitch length: satin crosses split above 7.0 mm, not 5.0 mm, so more long crosses
split_7mm.basis: PR #847: long_share (stitches over 4 mm) read BELOW chance against Kent, so he picks the side with FEWER long stitches. This arm adds long stitches, so the pre-registered pick is the base. 7.0 is the pro's own Becker style (docs/eye-pairs-2026-09-30); a candidate, not a setting.

fill_row_030.variable: thread density only: fill row spacing 0.30 mm against the shipped 0.15 mm, same construction
fill_row_030.basis: His words: 'the before stitch density is better' (density-1007). #847 found thread_density does NOT track his picks overall (-0.11), so this is the arm that tests it with nothing else moving. 0.30 is a probe at twice the settled 0.15, never a proposed setting (ROADMAP gate 1).

underlay_on_column.variable: trims only: a stroke's underlay is built on its column's own stations, so the hop between them is a stitch, not a lift
underlay_on_column.basis: Built OFF 2026-09-19 for Kent's flip: Becker 61 -> 48 trims at +481 stitches, nine logos 478 -> 465 (config.py). Trims is the one instrument that tracks his eye (kappa +0.55 sides only, #842/#847). If he picks this arm with no visible change the trims lead is causal; a tie says trims only proxies something he sees.

lane_off.variable: construction at matched pitch: the pre-flip satin skeleton tier for lettering (the Column lane's density correction of 2026-10-07 holds both sides at 0.40 mm)
lane_off.basis: Kent took the lane's side on 5 of 6 columns-flip pairs and on becker and drone in density-1007 (docs/density-flow-instrument-2026-10-12.md section 10), and flipped it ON 2026-10-12. This is the positive control: every lead metric moves on it together, so it carries the signal the other five arms try to separate.

reserve_arms.name: words

reserve_arms.name: exit_next_off
reserve_arms.variable: trims only: a column no longer exits toward the next one (reverts a shipped ON flag)

reserve_arms.name: hop_under
reserve_arms.variable: trims only: the in-shape hop to the next column is sewn needle-down where the column covers it

reserve_arms.name: per_stroke
reserve_arms.variable: satin vs fill call per stroke (differs on one of six logos, so a last resort)

manipulation.rule: An arm passes when, on at least 2 of the logos where its design differs from base AND on at least half of them, every `moves` metric changes in the stated direction by at least its threshold and every `holds` metric changes by less than its threshold. A failing arm is replaced by the first reserve of its stratum, once, before Kent sees a picture; the swap and the reason go in the manifest. An arm identical to base on 4 or more of the 6 logos is replaced the same way. Computed from the designs alone; no pick exists yet. (Amendment 2) A reserve that fails too, and a failing arm whose stratum has no reserve, STAY in the sitting flagged passes=false, never swapped a second time; the analysis reads the leads on all live pairs and, beside them, on the pairs of arms that passed alone.

primary.why: #847's one lead independent of trims (+0.16 ties in, one sitting's)
#847's reversed hypothesis, direction written down in advance: he picks FEWER long stitches
his notes say denser is better; #847 found no support
the control: the one instrument that cleared chance in #842 and #847; if it does not replicate here nothing else in this sitting is read

analysis.ci: percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261011, over pairs AND over designs (the `design` key of each logo)
analysis.reading_rule: both intervals clear of zero and at least 10 pairs where Kent chose a side; otherwise 'no evidence either way' or 'n too small'
analysis.population: live pairs (arm differs from base). Identical and repeat pairs are controls and enter no agreement statistic.
